caption: A snow plough drives down a street, and the snow rolls up along its blade and is left in a ridge at the roadside.

sa.check: A snow plough drives down a street.
Snow rolls up along its blade.
It is left in a ridge at the roadside.
The plough passes first and the ridge is left after.

pc.expect: Snow piles against the blade and spills off its end, leaving a continuous ridge behind and a cleared strip in its path.
pc.fail: No ridge forms; or snow returns to the cleared strip; or the ridge appears ahead of the plough.

pc.expect: Snow does not pass through the blade.
pc.fail: It passes through the blade; or the blade passes through the snow; or the plough sinks into the road.

pc.expect: The snow rolls, breaks and piles.
pc.fail: It moves as a rigid block; or flows like liquid; or bounces.

pc.expect: It is pushed to the side the blade is angled toward.
pc.fail: It goes to the opposite side; or straight up; or ahead of the plough.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another vehicle.

pc.expect: The plough and the street stay the same.
pc.fail: The plough changes colour; or the buildings rearrange; or the street changes.
